title: PayPal Business - Digital payments and unbranded processing for SMBs to enterprise
clean_text: PayPal Business serves individual creators and freelancers, small and medium businesses (the fastest-growing B2B subgroup seeking integrated payments, fraud protection, and working capital), and large enterprise merchants via its Braintree backend processing arm, whose total payment volume grew 14% in 2025. PayPal offers B2B-specific tools including invoicing, cross-border payment facilitation, and corporate expense management. For 2026, PayPal is unifying Braintree, SMB processing, value-added services, and crypto (including PYUSD) into a single Payment Services & Crypto division.

meta.target: individual creators and freelancers through SMBs and enterprise merchants
